paper_title: Narrative Media Framing in Political Discourse
caption: Distribution of FOCUS values across political leanings
model_annotation: The chart illustrates the distribution of FOCUS values across different political leanings, comparing the proportions of HERO, VICTIM, and VILLAIN categories. The horizontal axis lists four categories: Left bias, Left center bias, Quest source, and Right bias, which represent the different political leanings. The vertical axis represents the proportion of FOCUS values, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 in increments of 0.2. The chart features grouped bars, with each group consisting of three bars representing HERO (dark blue), VICTIM (brown), and VILLAIN (light blue). The HERO bars have values of approximately 0.35, 0.36, 0.48, and 0.27 for Left bias, Left center bias, Quest source, and Right bias, respectively. The VICTIM bars have values of around 0.47, 0.55, 0.48, and 0.38 for the corresponding categories. The VILLAIN bars consistently have a value of 1.0 across all categories. The bars are grouped by category, with no specific sorting or visual emphasis observed.
